newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Ayala Land picked to develop govt land.
newsitem.headline: Ayala Land picked to develop govt land.

text.p: Real estate giant Ayala Land Inc said on Tuesday it had been chosen by government pension fund, Government Service Insurance System (GSIS), as its partner to develop a three-hectare prime lot in suburban Quezon city.
Ayala senior vice president Mercedita Nolledo said the joint venture is still to be approved by the GSIS board of trustees.
Ayala is planning to develop the lot into a mixed-use residential, commercial and hotel complex.
The lot will be sold to the joint venture company at 40,000 pesos per square metre.
"Upon obtaining the formal confirmation and approval of the Board of Trustees of the GSIS ... the parties shall commence negotiations on the other terms of their joint venture," Nolledo added.
